title: Setting Austin Wages & Ben White Road Costs
summary:
*   **New Prevailing Wage Scale Adopted:** After a lengthy discussion with contractors and labor unions, the council formally approved a detailed prevailing wage scale for numerous construction trades (e.g., bricklayers, electricians, plumbers). This scale would apply to city projects, including an upcoming reservoir.
*   **Ben White Boulevard Expansion Funding:** The city agreed to a cost-sharing plan with Travis County to acquire land for the Ben White Boulevard right-of-way, with Austin committing to pay 3/5ths of the property acquisition costs.
*   **Proposed Gas Contract Reviewed:** Council members held a detailed discussion with an advisory committee regarding a new proposed gas contract, reviewing its terms and gathering feedback, though no final decision was made during this meeting.
